# AI Community Intertidal Clean up

Group Questions: Species occurrence: For a selected taxon or group, where and when was it recorded? Make an occurrence or detection-frequency summary, explicitly distinguishing absence from not surveyed and accounting for sampling effort.

# Cleaning Data

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(mapproj)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(maptiles)
library(tidyterra)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(ggspatial)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
read.csv("Data")
```

## AI Conversations

### Plotting

#### AI generated plots:

Mapping Oʻahu

```{r}
oahu_bbox <- st_as_sfc(
  st_bbox(c(xmin = -158.35, ymin = 21.22,
            xmax = -157.60, ymax = 21.75),
          crs = 4326)   # WGS84 lat/lon
)

tiles_satellite <- get_tiles(
  oahu_bbox,               # the area to download
  provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", # which tile source to use
  zoom = 16,                  # level of detail (3 = continent, 20 = building)
  crop = TRUE,                # clip to our exact bbox (vs. slightly larger)
  cachedir = here("data") # save tiles to disk
)

class(tiles_satellite)
```

```{r}
# geom_spatraster_rgb() is from {tidyterra}
# It reads the 3 color layers and renders them as a photo
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster_rgb(data = tiles_satellite) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world")

head(world)

Hawaii <- world |>
  filter(subregion == "Hawaii")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = Hawaii,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group),
               color = "black") +
  coord_map() +
  theme_void()



```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = CA_data,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group),
               color = "black") +
  coord_map() +
  theme_void()

region_names <- maps::map("worldHires", plot = FALSE, namesonly = TRUE)
oahu_regions <- grep("Oahu", region_names, value = TRUE)
if (length(oahu_regions) == 0) {
  stop("No 'Oahu' region found in mapdata::worldHires. ",
       "Check: grep('Hawaii', maps::map('worldHires', plot = FALSE, namesonly = TRUE), value = TRUE)")
}
oahu <- maps::map("worldHires", regions = oahu_regions, fill = TRUE,
                  plot = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf()
if (is.na(st_crs(oahu))) st_crs(oahu) <- 4326
bb <- st_bbox(oahu)
```

Location x year presence/absence/not-surveyed tile map (the core figure)

```{r}
p_tile <- ggplot(state_loc_year, aes(year, fct_rev(factor(location)), fill = state)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(n_events), "", n_events)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL,
       title = "Where and when was the taxon recorded?",
       subtitle = "Numbers = survey events; grey = no survey that year") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Detection frequency by location, with Wilson CI and effort labels

```{r}
p_loc <- freq_loc |>
  ggplot(aes(freq, fct_reorder(location, freq))) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_events)), nudge_y = 0.3, size = 2.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of survey events with detection", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Detection frequency through time (with effort bars underneath via patchwork if desired)

```{r}
p_year <- ggplot(freq_year, aes(year, freq)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_events)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Detection frequency", size = "Events") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Seasonality: detection frequency by calendar month

```{r}
p_month <- ggplot(freq_month, aes(factor(month, 1:12, month.abb), freq)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 1.02, label = n_events), size = 2.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Detection frequency", subtitle = "Numbers = survey events") +
  theme_minimal()
```
